# VEIL TRUTH
[color=#FF5050][bold]THEY DO NOT WANT YOU TO READ THIS PAGE[/bold][/color]
[italic]What the relay will not tell you. Independent, unfunded and unafraid. Run from a terminal they have not found yet.[/italic]
## TODAY'S TRUTHS - [bold]HADLEY'S HOPE.[/bold] One hundred and fifty eight families. One colony. Silence. The Company says it is cooperating with the appropriate authorities. Name one authority. You cannot. Neither can they. - [bold]THE COFFEE.[/bold] The vending coffee on your colony tastes the same as the vending coffee on every other colony. Every one. Ask yourself why. Then ask yourself why you sleep so well. - [bold]THE PROCESSOR.[/bold] Your atmosphere processor makes air. Fine. Then why does it need a staff of forty, a fence and a Company liaison who has never once been seen to breathe heavily? - [bold]THE HOLO STARS.[/bold] Rex Maddox has survived on forty hostile worlds without a single scar. We have done the maths. We have a theory. See the Synthetics page. - [bold]THE TATTLER.[/bold] Celebrity gossip is the oldest distraction in the book. While you read about noodles, they are reading about you.
## WHAT WE BELIEVE - Nobody goes quiet for no reason. - Special order means something. We do not know what. Yet. - The marines know more than they say. The marines always know more than they say. - Your bunkmate is probably fine. Probably.
